Name: PackRat
Author: moomeowmeme
Description:
[size=6][b]PackRat[/b][/size]
[i]Know what you have, keep it tidy, and let the harvest pick itself.[/i]

PackRat is for players with forty chests and no idea which one has the Blueberry Wine. Press [b]P[/b] for a menu that shows everything you own, everywhere on your farm, and everything you don't have yet. It adds two freezers, a Strongbox that locks, and three grabbers that do your collecting overnight, and lets you put a short label on any chest.

[line]

[size=5][b]The PackRat menu[/b][/size]
Press [b]P[/b], or click the PackRat button (a little packrat peeking out of a chest) on your backpack page or in any open chest.

[list]
[*][b]Everything in one place:[/b] every chest, freezer, fridge, mini-fridge, dresser, grabber, Auto-Grabber, Junimo chest, hopper and shipping bin, plus your backpack, what you're wearing, and the bait and tackle on your rods. Items you've donated to the museum or given to Community Center bundles count too.[/*]
[*][b]Every flavour on its own line:[/b] Blueberry Wine and Starfruit Wine are counted separately. So are each Jelly, Pickles, Juice, Dried Fruit, Dried Mushrooms, Honey, Roe, Aged Roe and Smoked Fish.[/*]
[*][b]Quality at a glance:[/b] each item shows the star of the best quality you have, and hovering it shows how many you have at normal, silver, gold and iridium quality.[/*]
[*][b]Where it is:[/b] the same hover lists which chests hold it, biggest first, using your chest labels.[/*]
[*][b]Find it:[/b] click an item to pin it, then click a chest row. A "Here!" marker bobs over that chest so you can walk straight to it.[/*]
[*][b]What you're missing:[/b] every item you don't have yet shows too, faded, including every possible flavour: every wine, jelly, juice, pickle, dried fruit, dried mushroom, honey, smoked fish, roe and aged roe the game can make.[/*]
[*][b]Tabs and search:[/b] Crops & Forage, Artisan Goods (grouped into Wine, Jelly, Pickles and so on), Animal Products, Fish, Cooking, Minerals, Resources and Everything Else.[/*]
[*][b]Filters:[/b] show everything, only what you have, or only what you're missing; count only silver, gold or iridium; count only one place, such as the Shed; or only one kind of storage, such as just your freezers or just your dressers; or only one type of item, such as vegetables, fruit, artifacts, mushrooms or wine. Sort by name, count or value.[/*]
[*][b]Totals:[/b] how many kinds of item you have out of everything there is, how many items you're storing, in how many containers, and what it's all worth.[/*]
[/list]
It's built only from the game's own menu pieces (boxes, title scroll, inventory slots, tooltips, quality stars and sounds), so it looks like it shipped with the game.

[line]

[size=5][b]Storage[/b][/size]

[b]Bulk Freezers[/b]
Two freezers that each hold 70 slots, as much as a Big Chest, and count as a fridge, so you can cook with what's inside. They keep themselves tidy: matching stacks merge the moment something goes in, so you never end up with three half-stacks of the same thing.
[list]
[*][b]Bulk Freezer (Keep Stars)[/b] (cream): merges stacks and leaves quality alone. Gold Potatoes stack with gold Potatoes and normal with normal.[/*]
[*][b]Bulk Freezer (No Stars)[/b] (icy blue): first drops everything to normal quality, so all your Potatoes end up in one stack of 300 instead of four stacks by quality.[/*]
[/list][color=#cc6600][b]The No Stars downgrade is permanent.[/b] Gold and iridium items lose their stars and their extra value. Keep your best items in the Keep Stars freezer or somewhere else.[/color]

[b]Strongbox[/b] (iron, with a brass padlock)
A locked box with [b]three pages of 70 slots: 210 in all[/b], three times a Big Chest. It only opens while you're [b]holding the Strongbox Key[/b]: select it in your toolbar, then open the box. The first time you try to open a Strongbox, you'll find a key taped to the lid, and that one key opens every Strongbox you own. Lose it, and Clint will make you a new one for 2,500g. It's in his shop whenever the key isn't in your backpack, so a key left in a chest, or locked inside a Strongbox, counts as lost.

[b]Chest labels[/b]
Give any chest a label of up to 3 characters, shown on a small parchment tag on its front. Point at a chest and press [b]L[/b], or open it and click the label button beside the chest menu. Leave the box blank to remove a label.

[line]

[size=5][b]Harvesting[/b][/size]

[b]Crop Grabber[/b]
Every night it picks every ready crop, garden pot and fruit tree within 5 tiles in every direction (an 11×11 square) and keeps the harvest inside itself (70 slots).

[b]Greenhouse Grabber[/b] (green)
The same, for the [b]whole building[/b] it's standing in: every crop and every fruit tree. Put one in your greenhouse and never walk the rows again.

[b]Artisan Grabber[/b] (wine red)
Every night it collects the finished goods from [b]every machine in the building[/b] it's standing in: kegs, preserves jars, casks, dehydrators, cheese presses, crystalariums and the rest. Machines that restart on their own when emptied, such as crystalariums and tappers, start their next batch just as if you'd collected by hand. Casks are collected once they reach iridium quality.

How the crop grabbers pick:
[list]
[*]Quality and yield follow the same rules as picking by hand: fertilizer and farming level count, one item per plant gets the quality roll and any extras are normal quality, and deluxe fertilizer still guarantees silver. Fruit tree quality comes from the tree's age.[/*]
[*]Sunflowers drop their seeds, wheat sometimes gives hay, and fiber sometimes gives mixed seeds, just like picking by hand.[/*]
[*]You get the same farming experience as picking by hand.[/*]
[*]Regrowing crops (blueberries, hops, coffee and so on) are left on the plant to regrow.[/*]
[*]Wild forage crops such as spring onions are left for you to pick.[/*]
[*]A full grabber stops picking, and the rest of the crop waits safely on the plant.[/*]
[*]A lightning-struck fruit tree gives coal, as it does in the base game.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

Manifest.Name: PackRat
Manifest.Description: Press P (or the PackRat button in your backpack or any chest) to see everything you have stored and everything you're still missing, with filters. Plus storage helpers: two self-stacking Bulk Freezers (one keeps quality, one flattens it to normal), a 210-slot Strongbox that only opens while you hold its key, a Crop Grabber (11x11), a Greenhouse Grabber (whole building) and an Artisan Grabber (empties every machine in its building). Label any chest: press L while pointing at it, or use the button in the chest menu.
Manifest.Author: annan
